name: InputGroupAddon
summary: What sits glued to the control inside an InputGroup: a glyph, a prefix, a button.

props.name: side
props.description: Which end of the group the addon is glued to. It is LOGICAL, not physical: in RTL "start" is the right-hand side.

props.name: layout
props.description: "block" puts the addon on its own line above or below the control instead of beside it — the shape a filter bar takes when it runs out of width. Responsive, so it can be inline on a wide screen and block on a narrow one.
